messages:
maria: quick note — PR #5278 is functionally ready but gofumpt is failing and there's a proto tag ordering nit. please see snippet.

maria: ```proto
message CreateUserRequest {
  string name = 1;
  string email = 3; // should be 2
  string user_id = 2; // ordering nit
}
```

alex: trivial, swap email & user_id, remove trailing comma in the generated struct. happy to approve once CI is green.

ryan: I can push a tiny commit to reorder the fields and run `gofumpt -w` on the package. @maria ok if I push to your branch?

maria: yes please, thx — branch is `maria/pr-5278-fix`. Keep it as a single commit.

ryan: done — pushed fix and forced a quick rebase. @dev-bot can you re-run checks for `pr-5278`?

dev-bot: CI: re-run requested by ryan. queued.

jess: scanning — looks fine. If CI passes, can one of the maintainers approve? we want to merge during the 4pm PT window today.

alex: will review in 10m and approve if green.

dev-bot: CI: all checks passed for pr-5278 (build, unit-tests, linters).

alex: Approved. :+1:

maria: thanks! i'll merge once the merge queue unlocks. tagging for release notes: `fix(proto): order fields to conform to conventions`

ryan: merged to main and deployed to staging :rocket:

maria: awesome, closing the loop — thanks everyone :pray:
